caps.zh: 一个智能体，扛不动一个庞大的目标。
caps.en: One agent can't carry one huge goal.

caps.zh: 智能体的循环，活在节点内部；
caps.en: The agentic loop lives inside each node;

caps.zh: 节点之间的边，是确定性的 Rust。
caps.en: the edges between them are deterministic Rust.

caps.zh: 就绪的节点三路并行，各占一棵工作树，
caps.en: Ready nodes run three at a time, each in its own worktree,

caps.zh: 最后，gn-final 重新验收整个目标。
caps.en: Finally, gn-final re-verifies the whole objective.

caps.zh: 确定性的骨架，智能的血肉。
